paragraphs: Caselle makes government accounting, ERP, and payments software. It is right-sized, in the company's words, for small to medium local governments, cities, and districts.

Accounting, utility billing, and reporting run in one system whose modules pass data to each other. Built-in tools produce audit-ready statements and track budgets in real time. Payroll and human resources are covered as well. So are permits and code enforcement. Business licensing and tax collection sit in the same system. A further set of tools is meant for sharing information with residents and collecting feedback.

Caselle dates its commitment to community to 1978. The company says its story began with Duane Hutchings, a CPA in Spanish Fork, Utah. Working with his sons and Spanish Fork City, he developed software to improve the workflows of people in local government. In 2024 Caselle joined Govineer Solutions. A published case study describes a city choosing Caselle after an extensive RFP process. That study says McPherson, Kansas explored six different government accounting software solutions before choosing Caselle. It reports the city saved four full workdays each month after the transition.
